guide.effecoria.title: Effecoria Magic Primer
guide.effecoria.toc_body: Chapters on the left. Click a title to jump. Scroll wheel, arrows, or click the pages to turn.
guide.effecoria.toc_hint: Choose a chapter on the left
guide.effecoria.cover_body: This volume grows as you advance. First — what matters most: hub, breath, the power bars. Later, new leaves will appear here — watch for NEW.
guide.effecoria.body.cast_loop: Welcome. Hold X: the Resonance Hub lights up before you — a constellation of your spells. Hover a node and release the key to choose a spell. Then hold R to charge and release to cast — a short tap is lighter, a full hold is full force. If the target slips away, some Ψ still leaves you: that is a whiff cast. Most combat spells can settle on ground or air; only a few living-only effects need a real creature.
guide.effecoria.body.psi_phi: Ψ is your personal power: the purple bar on screen. It recovers with breath and rest. Φ is the world’s breath around you: the blue bar. Under open sky the field is more generous; deep in caves it grows leaner and quieter. Craft Essonite Dust from an amethyst shard + glowstone dust + redstone, then a Resonance Focus and Phi Cell. The cell assists when Φ is thin and refills with essonite dust; under bright sky it recharges on its own. Sense Φ paints living gradients and anti-magic iron purple. Push power through empty channels and fatigue sets in.
guide.effecoria.body.entropy: Every cast slightly muddies the side currents — that is entropy, the amber-purple bar. At rest the bar settles on its own; faster still if you stand calm. Let it fill completely and backlash arrives: a sharp jolt, after which you simply breathe and do not rush.
guide.effecoria.body.breathing: Breathing is the thread that holds everything else. The deeper the mastery, the lighter spells settle and the farther your school’s path opens. In the hub, the left node glows for training — step in, catch the rhythm. Breathing technique scrolls, calm running, and swimming also teach the body not to tear the field. A short meditation clears entropy as if you were brushing ash from your palms.
guide.effecoria.body.hub_keys: Hold R — power and cost ramp up; release to cast. Tap ≈ 45%, full hold = 100%. Hold X — Resonance Hub. Alt+scroll cycles spells. Locked nodes wait on breathing and essence — and unlock in strict order: the next spell waits until the current one's gates are met.
guide.effecoria.body.seals: Seals write Φ onto stone and wood. Press G on a block to open the word editor. Erase a seal with Shift + empty-hand RMB (Seals school only) or by breaking the block. In the editor, Save/Load keep up to four expressions for later. Old words still work; new Φ-phonemes deepen the craft — Lux light, Clausura locks, Calor heat, Acies edge, Firmitas hardness, Umbra hides the glow, Servare freezes use, Extrahere drains Ψ, Imprimere stamps essonite, Ordo calms entropy, Abnegatio phases, Absolutum spends everything and breaks. Grammar: Count Three waits for the third pulse; Loop Five repeats; If / When opens a rule; Until Ten caps firings; Else is the early branch. Try See Player Count Three Hurt.
guide.effecoria.body.mental: Mental magic reads and rewrites minds. Empathic scan (Sense Φ) tastes surface feeling — strong pain can stun you. Ψ-whisper nudges leave; Psychic Barrier white-noises probes. Mind Probe digs deeper at trauma risk. Illusion swaps the victim's senses: observers do not hear the mirage or see its moral damage. Dominate puppets a body while you slow. Mental Servitude seizes a humanoid (not necro thralls) and takes work orders: dig a tunnel into a bound chest or haul items. False Memory clears aggro; Dream Lock binds night harder. Hive Mind links allies; Ψ-Copy baits without a soul; Total Illusion blankets a place — and may trap you too.
guide.effecoria.body.orkanum: Orkanum is the living vessel: hunger and air multiply your biology. When Orkanum reads low, eat and surface — Ψ regen thins and casts soften slightly until the body recovers. Walking and running fill the movement bar on the HUD; each full bar adds +1 max Ψ (your internal cast pool — 150 becomes 151). The breathing drill teaches rhythm; miss thrice and fatigue halves regen until you rest. Overcast borrows power you do not have and scars breath for a while. Hold cast (R) to charge — release early for a lighter working, hold for full force.
guide.effecoria.body.anti_magic: ZNΦ is zero flux: the field is cut off from Φ flow and casts fail. Dense iron and lead-like blocks (#effecoria:zero_flux) mute Φ within two blocks; cold iron (#effecoria:cold_iron) within one. Iron armor or an iron tool in hand also shields the wearer — remove the iron to cast again. Sense Φ paints those blocks purple and shows living Φ gradients.
guide.effecoria.body.elemental: Elemental magic shapes fire, water, ice, wind, steam, lightning, plasma and vacuum. Starters teach the four states: Fire Burst, Weak Breeze, Water Stream, Ice Shard. Later forms braid states — steam from heat and water, ionization from air. Ore Smelt and Hydro Slice are working tools, not starter toys: earn them with breath and essence. Watch Φ outdoors: sky and weather feed this school.
guide.effecoria.body.organic: Organic magic tends living tissue and green growth. Diagnostics and blood stasis open the path; sap, thorns, grafts and regeneration follow. Heals read as cellular light; combat works read as spores and leaves. Hunger and air are part of the working — Orkanum is the vessel.
guide.effecoria.body.necromancy: Necromancy bargains with death marks, bone and soul. Thralls are raised with a Death Mark budget, not free summons. Leash and line-of-sight keep the dead honest. Soul drains and wither touches demand breath discipline — entropy rises when you overreach.
guide.effecoria.body.corruption: Corruption stains and binds. Marks, rot, blight waves and miasma trade permanence for power. Cure tags exist for common and rare stains. Push too far and the field remembers your entropy.
guide.effecoria.body.spatial: Spatial magic folds distance: blinks, rifts, pockets and singularities. A missed anchor still spends Ψ.

guide.effecoria.body.school: In Effecoria an operator has one school — spectral purity: the voice you chose stays yours. Starter spells are a gift so you can hear your own timbre. From there, essence and breathing feed the path. Read the hints, return to the Primer, and let each new node feel earned, not handed out.
tip.effecoria.initiated: You are initiated. Hold X — hub. Hold R to charge power and cost, release to cast. The Primer is already in your inventory.
tip.effecoria.open_hub: Hub open. Hover a node and release X — choose a spell. Ghosts wait on breathing and essence: not a ban, the next step.
tip.effecoria.breathing: Left hub node — Breathing Technique drill. Catch the green pulse; scrolls and calm running also teach breath. Hungry or drowning thins Orkanum (Ψ regen and soft cast power).
tip.effecoria.first_cast: It worked — the field answered. Watch Ψ, Φ, and entropy: they will tell you when to catch your breath rather than chase backlash.
tip.effecoria.first_whiff: Soft miss: no target or block was found, but some Ψ still left you. That is how aim learns. For living-only spells, look more carefully — the world will answer.
tip.effecoria.entropy: Entropy is rising. Stop, draw a full breath and stand still — or simply rest. Magic loves pauses.
tip.effecoria.harness: Φ is thin here. Craft Essonite Dust (amethyst + glowstone + redstone), then a Phi Cell — it cushions low-Φ casts. Sneak+dust to refill.
tip.effecoria.seals: Seals: G on a block opens the editor. Erase with Shift + empty-hand RMB. Save/Load keep expressions. Try See Step Hurt by a doorway.
tip.effecoria.znphi: ZNΦ: nearby iron/lead, cold iron, or iron armor/tools mute casts. Unequip or step away — Φ returns. Primer chapter: Anti-magic.
tip.effecoria.progression: Spells unlock in strict order: meet breath and essence for the current node, then the next. Hub ghosts are a path, not a warehouse.

race.effecoria.human.overview: Jack of all trades. Learn fast, start a bit weaker at magic than other races.
race.effecoria.human.traits: Breathing practice levels up 5% faster. No big strengths or weaknesses.
race.effecoria.orc.overview: Tough fighters. Their bodies handle magic backlash better than most.
race.effecoria.orc.traits: +10% max health. Spells leave less magical stress and fatigue.
race.effecoria.elf.overview: Fine-tuned senses. Efficient casters who feel the world clearly.
race.effecoria.elf.traits: Spells cost 8% less magic. Sense-Phi lasts longer.
race.effecoria.dwarf.overview: Craft and stone people. Best when digging, building, and sealing.
race.effecoria.dwarf.traits: Mine faster, tougher armor. Seal magic costs 10% less.
race.effecoria.varanagi.overview: Body-focused monks. Magic feeds their flesh more than the world outside.
race.effecoria.varanagi.traits: Casting burns less hunger. Standing still slowly heals you. Climb walls and trees like vines; sprint+jump to scramble up in bursts.
race.effecoria.dryad.overview: Forest-bound. Nature magic loves them; other schools feel a bit off.
race.effecoria.dryad.traits: Organic spells +12% power; other schools −5%. Less hungry in forests.
race.effecoria.lonver.overview: Long-lived and patient. They store magic deep and last where others fade.
race.effecoria.lonver.traits: +15 max magic. Recover better in weak-magic places; fatigue fades slower.
race.effecoria.harpy.overview: Air people. Cliffs and falls scare them less than anyone else.
race.effecoria.harpy.traits: Sprint + 3 jumps to take off (elytra glide). Space climbs (hunger). Claws hit like an iron spear and hit harder the faster you move — dive into foes. Half fall damage.
message.effecoria.harpy.windup: Keep sprinting — jump again to build takeoff
message.effecoria.harpy.launch: Wings catch — glide like an elytra. Space to climb.
message.effecoria.harpy.starving: Too hungry to flap — eat before you climb
race.effecoria.vampire.overview: Magic from blood, not from rest. Daylight is dangerous without a helmet.
race.effecoria.vampire.traits: Magic regenerates half as fast. Drink blood vials to refill. Sun burns bare head.
message.effecoria.race_required: Choose a race first (join screen or Resonance Focus).
tip.effecoria.race: Race is permanent and changes how your body handles magic. Next: pick a school — or skip for now and use a Resonance Focus later.
school.effecoria.elemental.overview: Fire, water, ice, wind, and weather. Strongest under open sky where Φ is generous. Four states braid into steam, lightning, and storms.
school.effecoria.mental.overview: Read and rewrite minds: fear, illusions, control, links. High skill ceiling — mistakes tax you and your entropy.
school.effecoria.organic.overview: Living tissue, growth, and heals. Orkanum, hunger, and breath are part of every working. Combat reads as spores; support as cellular light.
school.effecoria.necromancy.overview: Death marks, bone, and soul. Thralls obey a Death Mark budget — not a free army. Leash and breath discipline keep the dead honest.
school.effecoria.spatial.overview: Fold distance: blinks, rifts, pockets. Anchors and misses still spend Ψ — feel the pull of the field, not just sparks.
school.effecoria.corruption.overview: Stains, rot, curses, and miasma. Power through entropy and lasting marks. Cleansing exists; overreach is remembered.
school.effecoria.seals.overview: Write Φ onto blocks with words and rules. Traps, light, fortify — the path to automation alongside mod tech.

message.effecoria.school_deferred: You walk without a school for now. Use a Resonance Focus when you are ready.

spell.effecoria.binding_seal.desc: Combat binding seal on a target.
spell.effecoria.blight_brand.desc: Marks a target with corruption. Combat binding seal on a target.
spell.effecoria.contagion_bloom.desc: AoE curse that spreads to the same creature type nearby.
spell.effecoria.hunt_pulse.desc: Strike and re-hunt every prey-marked target in range.
spell.effecoria.phase_slip.desc: Blink along your gaze; may slip through one thin solid.
spell.effecoria.prey_mark.desc: Marks prey: all hostile mobs within 64 blocks see and chase the target.
spell.effecoria.absolute_zero.desc: Extreme cold that nearly stops motion.
spell.effecoria.air_form.desc: Shift into a light air form; cast again to end it.
spell.effecoria.air_hand.desc: Grabs a target with a wind-formed hand; cast again to release.
spell.effecoria.air_ionization.desc: Charges the air with crackling ions.
spell.effecoria.air_shroud.desc: Elemental air shroud around the caster.
spell.effecoria.elemental_supremacy.desc: Brief mastery surge of elemental forces.
spell.effecoria.ember_volley.desc: Hurls a flaming orb that ignites targets and ground.
spell.effecoria.fire_burst.desc: Hurls a flaming orb that ignites targets and ground.
spell.effecoria.sear.desc: Seals one raw food item in your hand into its cooked form.
spell.effecoria.ore_smelt.desc: Flash-smelts a placed ore (or other furnace-smeltable) block you look at.
spell.effecoria.phi_thrust.desc: Push against the Φ-field to shove yourself along your look. Primary locomotion in hyperspace.
spell.effecoria.psi_adrenaline.desc: Flood muscles and nerves with Ψ — strength, speed, haste. Burns hard.
spell.effecoria.phi_glow.desc: Cold Φ-Cherenkov glow from skin or focus — dim light in the dark.
spell.effecoria.psi_charge.desc: Pour Ψ into a Phi Cell (held or in inventory).
spell.effecoria.psi_link.desc: Send a simple empathic pulse — danger — to another mind.
spell.effecoria.psi_ward.desc: Tighten your aura against corruption and mental assault. Continuous Ψ drain; recast to drop.
message.effecoria.common.glow: Cold Φ-light blooms on your skin.
message.effecoria.common.charge_need_cel: Need a Phi Cell that is not full.
message.effecoria.common.charge_full: That Phi Cell is already full.
message.effecoria.common.link_need_targe: Look at a living mind to link.
message.effecoria.common.link_no_mind: That vessel has no mind to reach.
spell.effecoria.great_fireball.desc: Massive fire orb that sheds flame and scorches a wide patch on impact.
spell.effecoria.hurricane_storm.desc: Wide storm of wind and debris.
spell.effecoria.hydro_slice.desc: High-pressure cutter that shreds soft targets, foliage, and weaker blocks.
spell.effecoria.ice_prison.desc: Encases the target in a temporary ice shell.
spell.effecoria.ice_shard.desc: Launches a piercing ice shard that slows hits.
spell.effecoria.ice_sheet.desc: Freezes the ground into a slick sheet.
spell.effecoria.lightning_spear.desc: Hurls a jagged lightning arc from your hand to the aim point.
spell.effecoria.plasma_bolt.desc: Fires a superheated plasma bolt that burns hard.
spell.effecoria.quasar.desc: A roaming fire-eye that accretes terrain, then sheds flaming mass as it dies.
spell.effecoria.sonic_lance.desc: Focused sonic spear along your aim.
spell.effecoria.steam_flight.desc: Steam-powered flight; drains Ψ while active.
spell.effecoria.steam_jet.desc: Scalding steam cone that leaves lingering fog.
spell.effecoria.tornado.desc: Spins up a short-lived tornado field.
spell.effecoria.vacuum_cage.desc: Imprisons foes in a crushing vacuum.
spell.effecoria.water_shield.desc: Water barrier that softens incoming hits.
spell.effecoria.water_shroud.desc: Elemental water shroud around the caster.
spell.effecoria.water_stream.desc: Lashes a pressurized water stream along your look.
spell.effecoria.weak_breeze.desc: Gentle starter breeze for practice casts.
spell.effecoria.wind_push.desc: Elemental working shaped by fire, water, air, or ice.
spell.effecoria.mental_push.desc: Shoves the target along your look.
spell.effecoria.mental_sting.desc: Clouds the mind and slows the body — no direct harm.
spell.effecoria.mind_bolt.desc: A bolt of fog that confuses and weakens the target.
spell.effecoria.mind_lance.desc: Clouds the mind, slows, and shoves the target along your look.
spell.effecoria.mind_probe.desc: Forces an exact dump: HP, AI, gear, effects. Risk of Psi trauma.
spell.effecoria.locus_echo.desc: Reads a blurred place-memory from the target — coordinates drift hundreds of blocks.
spell.effecoria.mind_terror.desc: Forces a creature to flee from you in panic.
spell.effecoria.mind_depress.desc: Crush the will into despair — rooted, weak, and blind.
spell.effecoria.mind_blank.desc: Wipe combat intent so the mind forgets who to fight.
spell.effecoria.cliff_urge.desc: Compels a creature to seek a drop and step off.
spell.effecoria.drown_urge.desc: Compels a creature to seek water and drown itself.
spell.effecoria.psychic_frenzy.desc: Drives a creature mad — it attacks anyone nearby.
spell.effecoria.mass_hysteria.desc: Each nearby mind gets a random compulsion: terror, cliff urge, drown urge, frenzy, or despair.
spell.effecoria.psychic_barrier.desc: White noise around your Psi: blocks scans. Long hold fatigues.
spell.effecoria.psychic_drain.desc: Steals focus — fatigues the target and restores your Ψ.
spell.effecoria.psychic_focus.desc: Psychic working that bends mind and motion.
spell.effecoria.psychic_scream.desc: Psi-scream: pain and disorientation. Strong minds may echo it back.
spell.effecoria.psychic_storm.desc: Waves of confusion across a wide field.
spell.effecoria.sense_phi.desc: Reads surface emotions nearby. Strong target pain can stun you.
spell.effecoria.psi_whisper.desc: Simple leave suggestion. Against base instincts — backlash.
spell.effecoria.mind_illusion.desc: On players — bone plains and blood lakes under a red sky; the body stands nauseated while the soul is hunted by light-spears. On mobs — blindness and confusion.
spell.effecoria.mind_dominate.desc: Temporary puppet: walks where you look. You are vulnerable.
spell.effecoria.mind_servitude.desc: Permanently seize a humanoid into mindless labor (not necro thralls); each reserves Ψ = max HP. Bind a chest with tools, then dig until the chest is full, or haul items. Recast the servant to release.
spell.effecoria.false_memory.desc: Clears aggro and rewrites memory. Crude cuts scar their Psi.
spell.effecoria.dream_lock.desc: Waking inside a dream. Stronger at night; raises b.
spell.effecoria.hive_mind.desc: Links minds into a net. Too many links blur the self.
spell.effecoria.psi_echo.desc: Soulless Psi bait-copy that pulls aggro.
spell.effecoria.total_veil.desc: Reality swap in a radius. Risk of believing your own mirage.
spell.effecoria.synaptic_overload.desc: Overloads synapses with confusion, slow, and weakness.
spell.effecoria.telekinetic_crush.desc: Lifts the target in crushing doubt — confusion and weakness, no HP damage.
spell.effecoria.thought_bomb.desc: Explodes a cloud of confusion around the target.
spell.effecoria.thought_lance.desc: Deep mind fog: confusion, slow, and brief blindness.
spell.effecoria.army_of_dead.desc: Mass animation of skeletons. Burns Psi and b; control frays when drained.
spell.effecoria.corpse_burst.desc: Bursts necrotic energy from a target.
spell.effecoria.dark_pact.desc: Contract with an Omega-autochthon: fierce ally and power, huge b spike. It may betray.
spell.effecoria.death_coil.desc: Coil of death energy at a target.
spell.effecoria.death_gate.desc: Short death-aspected blink with a damaging trail.
spell.effecoria.death_sense.desc: Sense dying life, recent death echoes, and corpse marks. Accumulates b.
spell.effecoria.grave_bind.desc: Binds the target with grave weight.
spell.effecoria.grave_leech.desc: Drains life from a target into you. Withering touch on contact.
spell.effecoria.grave_whisper.desc: Call a Psi-imprint of last moments. Loop risk — mental shock to bystanders.
spell.effecoria.lich_ascension.desc: Lich path: biology Q to 0, Psi fed by a phylactery surrogate (totem / nether star / end crystal).
spell.effecoria.lich_ward.desc: Station eternal husk guard. Without Psi upkeep it sleeps or goes rogue.
spell.effecoria.life_tap.desc: Damages a target and heals you for part of it.
spell.effecoria.phylactery_surge.desc: Feeds the phylactery during lich path and lashes wither around you.
spell.effecoria.raise_skeleton.desc: Soulless bone servant. Overfeeding Psi makes a drunk skeleton.
spell.effecoria.raise_zombie.desc: Raises a permanent zombie thrall (reserves Ψ while it lives).
spell.effecoria.shade_brood.desc: Calls several permanent shade thralls (each reserves Ψ).
spell.effecoria.shade_summon.desc: Spirit contract: combat thrall that may break the deal.
spell.effecoria.shade_swarm.desc: Calls a permanent shade thrall (reserves Ψ while it lives).
spell.effecoria.soul_anchor.desc: Anchors a soul to resist displacement.
spell.effecoria.soul_cataclysm.desc: Psi-surgery: fuse thralls into a Doll. Instability and a b spike.
spell.effecoria.soul_drain.desc: Drains life from a target into you.
spell.effecoria.soul_reaper.desc: Forbidden call: rip Psi from Rest along a fresh trail. Risk of a wrong return.
spell.effecoria.soul_shackle.desc: Psi-interrogation of memory. Souls may lie; coercion pollutes your Psi.
spell.effecoria.diagnostic_glimpse.desc: Reads vital signs of a target.
spell.effecoria.foreign_agent.desc: Seeds a hostile agent in the target.
spell.effecoria.gene_engineering.desc: Opens a gene-graft menu for a living target (or yourself).
spell.effecoria.organism_adaptation.desc: Adapts to where you are: ground speed, water breath, fire ward, or soft fall.
spell.effecoria.pain_inhibitor.desc: Dulls pain and shock: you still lose HP, but without knockback or stagger.
spell.effecoria.root_bind.desc: Imprisons the target in roots. Victims can struggle free; the cage can also be broken.
spell.effecoria.scorched_earth.desc: Burns organic matter in a patch.
spell.effecoria.symbiotic_graft.desc: Grafts a symbiotic buff onto a target.
spell.effecoria.vital_infusion.desc: Infuses a living target with heal and regeneration.
spell.effecoria.soothing_sap.desc: Cleanses poison, wither, and hunger, then mends the target.
spell.effecoria.vital_ward.desc: Wraps a living target in absorption and resistance.
spell.effecoria.adrenal_gift.desc: Grants a living target speed and strength.
spell.effecoria.thorn_lash.desc: A line of root-thorn spikes erupts along your aim.
spell.effecoria.verdant_mend.desc: Organic working over flesh, growth, and adaptation.
spell.effecoria.vitality_pulse.desc: Organic working over flesh, growth, and adaptation.

spell.effecoria.ward_glyph.desc: Inscribes a fortify seal on a block.
spell.effecoria.absolute_fold.desc: Metric cocoon: brief near-invulnerability. Risk of sealing yourself.
spell.effecoria.blink.desc: Short teleport along your gaze. Wall exits are refused for safety.
spell.effecoria.dimensional_anchor.desc: Locks a target into repeating the same actions toward where you stood. Risk of catching yourself; raises b.
spell.effecoria.far_blink.desc: Long jump. Without compass/beacon/anchor you may miss by tens of meters.
spell.effecoria.subspace_voyage.desc: Stable micro-world (subspace): refuge and lab outside ordinary space.
spell.effecoria.rift_excise.desc: Folds a small volume of matter into hyperspace — gone without drops.

message.effecoria.subspace.pressure: Φ-field presses on your Orkanum — soft, but constant.
message.effecoria.sear.need_raw: Hold raw food to sear it.
message.effecoria.ore_smelt.need_block: Look at a placed block to smelt.
spell.effecoria.fold_repulse.desc: Antigravity pulse from you. Does not spare allies.
spell.effecoria.gravity_snare.desc: Shift local down — walk walls. May cause nausea.
spell.effecoria.gravity_well.desc: Warps space across an area into a gravity bowl: foes crushed and pulled in.
spell.effecoria.phase_veil.desc: Phases you briefly out of harm.
spell.effecoria.rift_burst.desc: Burst from a closing rift — damages and breaks nearby blocks.
spell.effecoria.rift_slash.desc: Micro-portal through the target — a clean cut. Needs precision.
spell.effecoria.rift_yank.desc: Yanks a target through a rift to you.
spell.effecoria.spatial_singularity.desc: Phi-pulsar: soul-burn in a radius. Leaves you drained.
spell.effecoria.spatial_surge.desc: Surges spatial force outward and along your look, breaking blocks.
spell.effecoria.spatial_ward.desc: Bends projectile trajectories around you. Point-blank melee still hits.
spell.effecoria.void_lance.desc: Lance of void — pierces the target and cuts blocks along the beam.
spell.effecoria.void_step.desc: Opens a personal 9-slot pocket. On death the pocket dumps its contents.
spell.effecoria.warp_bolt.desc: Spatial sonar through connected caves: x-ray walls fade every 5 blocks. Near rifts the sense warps.

message.effecoria.necro.lich_already: You are already on the lich path

message.effecoria.spatial.far_no_anchor: No anchor — the jump may miss
message.effecoria.phase_slip.blocked: No clear phase landing (wall too thick?)
message.effecoria.spatial.cocoon_seal: The cocoon nearly sealed you in!
message.effecoria.spatial.loop_cast: The target is stuck repeating that moment toward your old position
message.effecoria.spatial.pocket_collaps: Spatial pocket collapsed — items spilled out
message.effecoria.crystal_forest_enter: Φ-mist beads between the crystal trunks
message.effecoria.omega_scar_enter: Causality frays — the Scar remembers other timelines
message.effecoria.omega_scar.cast_chaos: Ω-noise twists your cast — the Scar answers wrong.
message.effecoria.omega_scar.time_loop: A micro-loop snags you — for a breath, you already left.
message.effecoria.omega_scar.echo.1: …battle cries from a war that ended yesterday…
message.effecoria.omega_scar.echo.2: …footsteps of an army that is not here…
message.effecoria.omega_scar.echo.5: …something in the crack already knows your name…
message.effecoria.omega_scar.echo.6: …burnt sugar and cold light from below…
message.effecoria.vitrified_wastes_enter: Residual Phi still burns here — glass remembers the flash
message.effecoria.vitrified_storm_start: A Phi-storm rises — essonite dust scours the wastes
item.effecoria.vitrified_glass_sword.hin: Sharp Φ-glass blade — iron hit, fragile edge.
item.effecoria.vitrified_golem_core.hint: Sneak-use with a Phi Cell in the other hand to fully recharge it (consumes the core).
message.effecoria.essonite_dust_poison: Raw essonite dust burns the uninitiated.
message.effecoria.golem_core_cell_charge: Golem core drained — Phi Cell fully charged.
item.effecoria.giant_phi_nut.hint: Restores full Ψ for initiated mages. Poison to mundanes.
message.effecoria.emerald_canopy_enter: The canopy breathes — gravity loosens, mist thickens.
message.effecoria.giant_phi_nut_charged: The giant nut floods your Orkanum with Φ.
message.effecoria.giant_phi_nut_poison: Unfiltered canopy essence burns your veins.
guide.effecoria.body.technomagic: Technomancy is free craft. Era I–II: hearth and workshop. Era III: Ψ-imprinter (MED heat + cell + focus) imprints golem chassis and telegraph modules. Deploy an imprinted chassis for a tame Φ-construct (needs Φ-cell charge). Pair Φ-telegraphs and pulse with flask/paper. Later eras remain planned.
message.effecoria.phi_campfire_lit: Φ seeps into the coals — LOW heat.
tooltip.effecoria.phi_torch: Soft Φ light — a hint of field, not a heat source.
tooltip.effecoria.phi_campfire: Feed essonite dust or shards. Provides LOW Φ-heat for crucibles.
tooltip.effecoria.clay_crucible: Place beside a lit Φ-campfire or burner. Ore/crystal → shard (lossy).
tooltip.effecoria.phi_furnace: Needs neighbor Φ-heat. Shard→pure essonite; dust/sand→Φ-glass.
Primitive LOW heat. Fuel with essonite dust/shards.
technomagic.effecoria.node.clay_crucible: Slow ore→shard over heat; waste cobble common.
technomagic.effecoria.node.essence_burne: MEDIUM Φ-heat for alembic and furnace.
technomagic.effecoria.node.phi_furnace.d: Refine shards and bake Φ-glass on the heat bus.
technomagic.effecoria.node.glass_worksho: No multiblock — Φ-furnace + craft flasks from Φ-glass.
technomagic.effecoria.node.essence_alemb: Distill Φ potions beside a fueled burner.
technomagic.effecoria.node.phi_cell.desc: Portable Φ assist for thin fields.
technomagic.effecoria.node.psi_imprinter: Imprints chassis and telegraph modules with Ψ using MED heat.
technomagic.effecoria.node.golem_chassis: Imprint then deploy a friendly Φ-construct.
technomagic.effecoria.node.telegraph.des: Pair two telegraphs; pulse short messages same-dimension.
item.effecoria.golem_chassis.imprinted: Imprinted (tier %s) — use on ground to deploy.
tooltip.effecoria.psi_imprinter: Needs MED+ Φ-heat, charged Φ-cell, and Resonance Focus.
tooltip.effecoria.telegraph_module: Blank module — imprint into a Φ-telegraph.
message.effecoria.telegraph_anchor_set: Telegraph anchor set — click another telegraph to pair.
message.effecoria.telegraph_same: Cannot pair a telegraph to itself.
message.effecoria.telegraph_cross_dim: Cross-dimension telegraphy is not ready yet.
message.effecoria.telegraph_need_cell: Insert a charged Φ-cell into the telegraph.
tooltip.effecoria.shaft_lathe: Choose shaft length (up to player height) and carve with MED Φ-heat. Material sets Φ-conductivity.
tooltip.effecoria.facet_cutter: Cut focus facets with MED Φ-heat.
item.effecoria.modular_staff.hint: Assembled shaft + focus. Hold to empower casts.
item.effecoria.item_seal_primer.hint: Seals mages: unlock a random item seal.
item.effecoria.phi_phoneme.hint_part: Also works on carved shafts / faceted foci.
message.effecoria.phoneme_need_part: Inscribe phonemes on shaft/focus before assembly.
message.effecoria.item_seal_need_seals: Only Seals school can use this.
message.effecoria.item_seal_all_known: You already know every item seal.
message.effecoria.item_seal_incompatible: Seal cannot bind to this item.
message.effecoria.item_seal_unknown: You have not discovered this seal.
